from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_path=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u085/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8434da5a.py')
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y, x in cells)
            exterior = set()
            q = deque()
            for y in range(minr, maxr + 1):
                for x in range(minc, maxc + 1):
                    if (y in (minr, maxr) or x in (minc, maxc)) and grid[y][x] == 0:
                        exterior.add((y, x))
                        q.append((y, x))
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if minr <= ny <= maxr and minc <= nx <= maxc and grid[ny][nx] == 0 and (ny,nx) not in exterior:
                        exterior.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            hollow = any(grid[y][x] == 0 and (y,x) not in exterior
                         for y in range(minr, maxr + 1) for x in range(minc, maxc + 1))
            objects.append({'color': color, 'cells': cells, 'hollow': hollow,
                            'minr': minr, 'maxr': maxr})

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    occupied = set()
    for obj in sorted((o for o in objects if o['hollow']), key=lambda o: o['minr']):
        shift = 0
        while min(r + shift for r, c in obj['cells']) > 0 and all((r + shift - 1, c) not in occupied for r, c in obj['cells']):
            shift -= 1
        for r, c in obj['cells']:
            nr = r + shift
            out[nr][c] = obj['color']
            occupied.add((nr, c))
    for obj in sorted((o for o in objects if not o['hollow']), key=lambda o: -o['maxr']):
        shift = 0
        while max(r + shift for r, c in obj['cells']) < h - 1 and all((r + shift + 1, c) not in occupied for r, c in obj['cells']):
            shift += 1
        for r, c in obj['cells']:
            nr = r + shift
            out[nr][c] = obj['color']
            occupied.add((nr, c))
    return out
'''
program_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path.write_text(code)
